name: flynn_signed_visual_motor_corridor_tuned
description: FLYNN signed-tanh dynamics with a non-saturating gain/leak setting selected by recorded-frame replay.
notes: Edit this file directly, save it, then run run_auto_recording.cmd.
Run check_experiment.cmd only when you want to validate the JSON before starting.
gain=2.0 and leak=0.3 produced no saturation through 200 post-stimulus ticks in recorded-frame replay.
case_seconds=3.5 gives 60 post-stimulus neural ticks after the 0.5 second onset.
Allowed equation names: h, recurrent, sensory, gain, leak, bias.
Allowed equation functions: tanh, maximum, minimum, clip, abs.
The trained FLYNN model learns weights, cell-type leak and bias; this experiment does not.
